// Unsharp-mask sharpening: Amount scales the high-frequency difference added
// back; Radius is the blur extent; Threshold suppresses sharpening where the
// local difference is below it (noise protection).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unsharp_masking)
type UnsharpMaskParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Number;
    Amount: Number;
    Threshold: Number;
}
